focus: the two small follow-ups: ClearStatCaches restored in Begin, stageDirty handled in the hidden CurStage branch
diffSource: since build 41 (2026-10-06T17:55:21Z), the last reviewed build, from the build log

findings.title: Stat caches are now cleared twice per OnGUI event while a hiding card is open
findings.detail: DrawStatsReport(Rect, Thing) runs on every OnGUI event, and Begin now loops over every StatDef calling ClearCacheForThing, as End already did, alongside two Notify_CapacityLevelsDirty calls. The card's stat entries are cached after the first draw (StatsReportUtility.cs:88-98), so the main cost is gameplay recomputing this pawn's stats and capacities while the card is open. I don't think it matters at vanilla stat counts and didn't measure it. If it ever shows up in a profile, skipping the Begin clear when the card's stat entries are already cached is one place to cut it.

findings.title: Class comment still says stat caches are dropped only after the card draws
findings.detail: The TitanHiding comment says everything the card computed is dropped 'as soon as the card finishes drawing'. With this change the caches are also cleared before the card draws, so the card can't read real cached values. One sentence in the comment would cover why Begin clears.

findings.title: cardStage comment says it is dropped when the card finishes drawing, but End never clears it
findings.detail: End() clears cardPawn and hiddenHediffs but leaves Hediff_Titan.cardStage alone. It lasts until stageDirty is handled or a trait is discovered (lines 372, 462, 470). That behaviour is correct; only the comment is wrong.

checked: Begin's ClearStatCaches only removes this pawn's stat cache entries (StatWorker.ClearCacheForThing, StatWorker.cs:1373) and closes the leak of real cached values into the card's stat reads
Begin only clears when it actually starts hiding (titan with a hidden trait, no card already open, main thread)
Hidden CurStage branch: on stageDirty it rebuilds cachedStage, clears the flag and drops cardStage, matching the normal branch (Hediff_Titan.cs:458-472)
Every place that sets stageDirty (lines 101, 333, 352, 779) now also rebuilds the card stage, including the material change in SettingsChanged
Notify_TraitDiscovered clearing only cardStage is enough, because the real stage doesn't change on discovery
TraitsChanged's comparison of old and new stage (cachedStage and CurStage) happens outside the hidden window and is unaffected
All 4 [HarmonyPatch] targets in TitanHiding.cs bind (verify_patches); DrawStatsReport picks the (Rect, Thing) overload
The DrawStatsReport prefix returns void, cannot skip the original, and the finalizer always ends hiding (prefix-returns-void)
No scanned corpus mod patches DrawStatsReport, Hediff.CurStage or Ability.GizmosVisible, so nothing is shared to break
pyxis_mod_errors not checked: no Pyxis token is configured
